# PART 9 – RESPONDING TO PARTICULARS OF CLAIM – GENERAL

[PART 9 – RESPONDING TO PARTICULARS OF CLAIM – GENERAL] Contents of this Part

[PART 9 – RESPONDING TO PARTICULARS OF CLAIM – GENERAL] Title | Number

[PART 9 – RESPONDING TO PARTICULARS OF CLAIM – GENERAL] Defence, admission or acknowledgment of service | Rule 9.2

## Scope of this Part

## 9.1

[PART 9 – RESPONDING TO PARTICULARS OF CLAIM – GENERAL > 9.1] (1) This Part sets out how a defendant may respond to particulars of claim.

[PART 9 – RESPONDING TO PARTICULARS OF CLAIM – GENERAL > 9.1] (2) Where the defendant receives a claim form which states that particulars of claim are to follow, he need not respond to the claim until the particulars of claim have been served on him.

## Defence, admission or acknowledgment of service

## 9.2 When particulars of claim are served on a defendant, the defendant may –

[PART 9 – RESPONDING TO PARTICULARS OF CLAIM – GENERAL > 9.2 When particulars of claim are served on a defendant, the defendant may –] (a) file or serve an admission in accordance with Part 14;

[PART 9 – RESPONDING TO PARTICULARS OF CLAIM – GENERAL > 9.2 When particulars of claim are served on a defendant, the defendant may –] (b) file a defence in accordance with Part 15,

[PART 9 – RESPONDING TO PARTICULARS OF CLAIM – GENERAL > 9.2 When particulars of claim are served on a defendant, the defendant may –] (or do both, if he admits only part of the claim); or

[PART 9 – RESPONDING TO PARTICULARS OF CLAIM – GENERAL > 9.2 When particulars of claim are served on a defendant, the defendant may –] (c) file an acknowledgment of service in accordance with Part 10.
